encoder: a single Sonnet 5.5 agent (claude-sonnet-5-5) working alone from the brief, with no subagents; run porridge-uk-spc-b
display_name: State Pension Credit Act 2002: the whole Act in L4, with a claimant seat layer
maintainer: Legalese Commons (no individual maintainer assigned yet)
seat: a person who is, or is about to be, of an age to claim State Pension Credit, asking whether they are entitled to it, how much, and what they must do or tell the authorities
method: A single Sonnet 5.5 agent working alone from the brief, in one context: layer 1 written from the text alone, then the seat layer over it; tests hand-written from the text; checked with the l4 diagnostics.

scope.encoded: Sections 1 to 10, 12(1), 15, 16, 17 (the definitions that carry a test, and 'entitled'), 18A(1) and (5), 22(2), (3) and (6); Schedule 1 paragraphs 3(3), 12 and 13; Schedule 2 paragraphs 2, 4, 17, 26 and 30.
scope.not_encoded: Powers to make regulations and their procedure (ss 3(6), 7(7), 12(2) to (4), 13, 15(3) to (7), 16(2), 17(2), 18A(2) to (11), 19), financial and repeal provisions (ss 20, 21, Schedule 3), and amendments of other Acts that insert a name into a list (Schedule 1 paragraphs 2 to 11 and nearly all of Schedule 2). Every amount, rate, threshold and period the Act leaves to regulations is a plain input.

edition.text: ../../registers/source-bundle/ukpga-2002-16.txt, a plain-text rendering by a converter script of legislation.gov.uk ukpga/2002/16, point in time 2026-07-01 (latest revised version at retrieval on 2026-10-19). It is not the official text and nothing is verified against the official text.
edition.caveat: The register lists 1 outstanding effect not applied to this text (s. 3A(5)(a), words omitted by the Welfare Reform and Work Act 2016 s. 20(8), in force 2018-04-06) and 24 prospective effects; see NOTES.md.

checks.srcrefs: python3 -I srcrefs.py check --refs ../../../../../registers/source-bundle/ukpga-2002-16.txt spc-*.l4: 0 problems (see NOTES.md for the exact line)
checks.mutation_controls: six edits to layer-1 rules each turned 1 to 13 layer-1 assertions red; two edits turned seat assertions red (NOTES.md, Tests)

L4_BIN_version: 1.6.98 (the stable build the brief names; JL4_LIBRARY_PATH left unset)
not_reviewed: No domain expert has read this encoding against the text, official or deposited. It was written, tested and checked by the encoder alone; the expected values in the tests were worked out by the same agent that wrote the rules. See NOTES.md, 'What would need doing before this encoding is worth relying on'.
